  "When melanoma is suspected, the entire lesion should be completely excised with a margin of 1–3 mm to allow histological diagnosis.",
  "Incisional biopsies can be performed on large lesions located on the face (e.g., lentigo maligna), on acral skin, and on the genitalia.",
  "The consensus rate for this recommendation is 100 % (21 out of 21 experts).",
  "Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is the recommended first‑line treatment for primary cutaneous melanoma of any thickness and for melanoma in situ.",
  "Surgical margins for melanoma should be determined based on tumor thickness.",
  "Sentinel lymph node biopsy, when indicated, should be performed before wide excision of the primary melanoma.",
  "Sentinel lymph node biopsy should be performed in the same operative setting as wide excision whenever possible."
]
